+"""Camera-guided plate sliding controller; one client, no resets.
+
+Run interactively and supply JSON commands. Every observation and command is
+recorded alongside the script so the executed procedure can be reviewed.
+"""
+import json
+import sys
+from pathlib import Path
+
+import numpy as np
+from PIL import Image, ImageDraw
+
+sys.path.insert(0, "/opt/tools")
+from rcb_client import Robot
+
+OUT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
+r = Robot()
+spec = r.spec()
+(OUT / "spec.json").write_text(json.dumps(spec, indent=2))
+cams = list(spec["cameras"])
+counter = 0
+obs = None
+
+
+def record(result, label):
+    global counter, obs
+    obs = result
+    folder = OUT / f"{counter:03d}_{label}"
+    result.save(str(folder))
+    canvas = Image.new("RGB", (640, 520), "white")
+    draw = ImageDraw.Draw(canvas)
+    for i, cam in enumerate(cams):
+        if cam in result.last:
+            x, y = (i % 2) * 320, (i // 2) * 260
+            canvas.paste(Image.fromarray(result.last[cam]), (x, y + 20))
+            draw.text((x + 5, y + 3), cam, fill="black")
+    canvas.save(folder / "views.png")
+    p = result.meta["proprio"]
+    state = dict(zip(p["layout"], p["now"]))
+    print(json.dumps({"record": str(folder), "proprio": state,
+                      "target": result.meta.get("task"),
+                      "time_left_s": result.meta.get("time_left_s"),
+                      "control_steps": result.meta.get("control_steps"),
+                      "done": result.meta.get("done")}), flush=True)
+    counter += 1
+    return state
+
+
+def act(actions, label):
+    actions = np.asarray(actions, dtype=np.float64)
+    np.save(OUT / f"actions_{counter:03d}.npy", actions)
+    return record(r.submit("ee_delta", actions, dt=spec["control_dt"],
+                           cameras=cams, video="both", include_depth=True,
+                           note=label), label)
+
+
+record(r.get_obs(cameras=cams, include_depth=True), "initial")
+print("READY", flush=True)
+for line in sys.stdin:
+    try:
+        command = json.loads(line)
+        with (OUT / "commands.jsonl").open("a") as log:
+            log.write(json.dumps(command) + "\n")
+        op = command["op"]
+        if op == "observe":
+            record(r.get_obs(cameras=cams, include_depth=True,
+                             seconds=command.get("seconds", 0)), "observe")
+        elif op == "act":
+            actions = command.get("actions")
+            if actions is None:
+                actions = [command["action"]] * command["steps"]
+            act(actions, command.get("label", "act"))
+        elif op == "move":
+            target = np.array(command["target"], dtype=float)
+            grip = command.get("grip", -1.0)
+            for _ in range(command.get("batches", 8)):
+                p = obs.meta["proprio"]
+                state = dict(zip(p["layout"], p["now"]))
+                tcp = np.array([state["tcp_" + ax] for ax in "xyz"])
+                delta = target - tcp
+                if np.linalg.norm(delta) < command.get("tolerance", 0.003):
+                    break
+                # Small feedback batches, each capped to the remaining distance.
+                n = command.get("batch_steps", 5)
+                u = np.clip(delta / (0.01 * n),
+                            -command.get("speed", 0.5), command.get("speed", 0.5))
+                act([list(u) + [grip]] * n, command.get("label", "move"))
+        elif op == "stop":
+            print("STOPPED: no more control steps will be submitted.", flush=True)
+            break
+        else:
+            raise ValueError("unknown op")
+        print("READY", flush=True)
+    except Exception as exc:
+        print(f"ERROR: {type(exc).__name__}: {exc}", flush=True)
*** End Patch"));

+"""Estimate the visible plate surface from calibrated RGB-D observations."""
+import json
+import sys
+from pathlib import Path
+
+import numpy as np
+from PIL import Image
+from scipy import ndimage
+
+folder = Path(sys.argv[1])
+meta = json.loads((folder / "meta.json").read_text())
+for cam in meta["cameras"]:
+    depth = np.load(folder / f"depth_{cam}.npy").squeeze().astype(float)
+    rgb = np.array(Image.open(folder / "last" / f"{cam}.jpg")).astype(float)
+    cal = meta["cameras"][cam]
+    k = np.array(cal["intrinsic_cv"])
+    transform = np.array(cal["cam2world_gl"])
+    vv, uu = np.indices(depth.shape)
+    local = np.stack([(uu - k[0, 2]) * depth / k[0, 0],
+                      -(vv - k[1, 2]) * depth / k[1, 1], -depth], axis=-1)
+    world = local @ transform[:3, :3].T + transform[:3, 3]
+    mask = ((world[..., 2] > .027) & (world[..., 2] < .033)
+            & (world[..., 1] > .45) & (world[..., 1] < .85)
+            & (abs(world[..., 0]) < .3)
+            & (rgb.max(axis=-1) - rgb.min(axis=-1) < 22)
+            & (rgb.mean(axis=-1) < 110))
+    labels, count = ndimage.label(mask)
+    candidates = []
+    for i in range(1, count + 1):
+        selected = labels == i
+        if selected.sum() < 10:
+            continue
+        points = world[selected]
+        candidates.append({"pixels": int(selected.sum()),
+                           "mean": points.mean(axis=0).tolist(),
+                           "min": points.min(axis=0).tolist(),
+                           "max": points.max(axis=0).tolist()})
+    print(cam, json.dumps(candidates))
*** End Patch"));
